title: One remembered instant outweighs filth
summary: One clean instant of remembrance outweighs a filthy habit. Trust one clean instant to break an old habit.
takeaway: Trust one clean instant to break an old habit.
lifeApplication: When shame says a small return is useless, remember once with your whole attention and let that instant interrupt the pattern.
